content.text: Night waking does happen at 8, often when she's got a lot on her mind or her sleep rhythm has slipped. It's common enough to be worth fixing but not alarming. Tonight, try a calm 10-minute wind-down before lights out: screens off an hour earlier, then a quiet chat about anything on her mind. If she wakes at 2am, walk her back to bed with as little talk and light as you can. A steady wake time every morning, weekends included, helps too. If it keeps up or she seems unwell, check with her doctor.
